about: Forms an army under this lord: the named lords march to the meeting place and join it there. The game charges the leader's clan its usual influence for each lord called. Lords who cannot come (in a battle, too far, already in an army) are left out, and you are told which.
calls_back: the army has formed, it has waited wait_hours, or it broke up

wait_hours: how long to wait for the lords before going on with whoever came

wait.about: waiting at {at} for the army: {army_lords} lords, {army_coming} still coming

when.poke: {me}'s army broke up before it formed.
{me}'s army has formed at {at}: {army_lords} lords, {men} men, strength {strength}.
{me} waited {wait_hours} hours at {at}; going on with {army_lords} lords, {men} men ({army_coming} never came).

ready.about: the army is ready at {at}, waiting for your order
